note: Each example is one video's rows from the action CSV (video_id, action_id, action_name, start_frame, end_frame): overlapping fine verb-object segments, several hundred per ~10-min assembly. Frame names count frames at 12 fps (timeline = frame/12). There are no step, mistake or language labels; undo actions (unscrew, pull_screw) are the only trace of errors. The project states no license.
